description: §15.10.1 (S458 fourth round, F4) — a string literal with escapes, or with quotes, inside an attribute `${…}` of a component body round-trips in EVERY form, as it does outside a component: unquoted `title=${label + 'it\'s'}` and `${label + "\"q"}` (were E-COMPONENT-021 'Unterminated tag': the component re-parse's opener scan did not honour escapes inside code strings), quoted `title="${label + "\\"}"` and `title="${label + "x"}"` (were E-SCOPE-001 on a truncated `label +`: the quoted-value reader ended the value at the first `"` inside the interpolation), and the mixed `title="x${label + 'it\'s'}y"`.
rationale: §15.10.1 substitutes the caller value for identifier references only; the rest of the attribute is the author's text and is preserved — a component body reads an attribute exactly as markup outside a component does.
